feature: First-run redesign — an account with a collection and no decks
note: Signed in as an account that owns cards and has no decks. Home shows the No decks yet section with its ghost New deck, and /decks shows the same pair. Both draw `DecksZeroActions`: Home through `HomeDecksZero`, which imports it, and /decks through `DecksZero`, which renders it from the module that defines it. There is no `shares` block, because `check:shared` asserts an import in every row's view and /decks' view has none by construction; the sameness is that one definition, and Home's import of it is read by eye.
